title: Pressure Loss in Pipes connected in Series or Parallel
description: Calculate pressure loss in pipes connected in series or parallel. For series configuration, total pressure loss is the sum of individual losses and mass flow is constant. For parallel configuration, pressure loss is the same in all pipes and total mass flow is the sum of individual flows.

components.content:
## Pipes in Series

For pipes connected in series the pressure loss is the sum of the individual losses:

**dp = dp1 + dp2 + ... + dpn**

Where:
- dp = total pressure loss (Pa, psi)
- dp1..n = individual pressure loss in each pipe (Pa, psi)
- m = m1 = m2 = ... = mn (mass flow rate is constant)

## Pipes in Parallel

For pipes connected in parallel the pressure loss is the same in all pipes:

**dp = dp1 = dp2 = ... = dpn**

The total mass flow is the sum of the flow in each pipe:

**m = m1 + m2 + ... + mn**

Where:
- dp = pressure loss (Pa, psi)
- m = total mass flow (kg/s, lb/s)
